marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

What landed (keymap phase of the jump-panel epic):

- New Agents-only `toggle_agent_jump_panel` on `.`, inert until the panel phase: availability and palette gating use `getattr` for `jump_panel_toggle_available`, and the action calls `toggle_jump_panel_expanded()` only when present. On Agents, `.` is now a clean no-op.
- Non-run toggle moved to new `toggle_hide_non_run_agents` on `I`; `toggle_hide_reverted` narrowed to Services axe commands; new tab-disjoint registry pairs for the three `.` owners.
- Updated command palette (jump entry AGENTS_ONLY + gated; `toggle_hide_reverted` narrowed to Services; new non-run entry), help modal (row moved from General into Agent Actions, no jump row advertised early), `docs/ace.md`, and `docs/configuration.md` allowlist.
- Tests: extended keymap defaults/bindings/validation, palette wiring, availability, and key-resolution suites; new [test_agents_non_run_toggle_keys.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_40/tests/ace/tui/test_agents_non_run_toggle_keys.py) proving `I` toggles and `.` no longer does on Agents while still toggling axe commands on Services.

Verification: 197 targeted tests pass; fmt, ruff, mypy, feature-flags, test-waits, and toobig are green; `epic-symbols` clean. Full `just check` can't go fully green on this tree: pyscripts and symvision fail only on pre-existing files I didn't touch, and the scoped suite (45k+ passing) has 13–14 failures in bead/prompt-history/query-profile areas — none reference the new symbols and the set varies between runs. No PNG goldens affected (no widget in this phase).

Declaration accepted for the commit payload (bead already closed, so declared with keep). No other work done on this recovery turn.
